newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hino says it, Salim, S'tomo in Indonesia venture.
newsitem.headline: Hino says it, Salim, S'tomo in Indonesia venture.

text.p: Hino Motors Ltd said on Wednesday it was planning to form a joint venture with Indonesia's Salim Group to assemble trucks in Indonesia from late 1998.
The veture, which will be capitalised at about 2.2 billion yen, will be owned 51 percent by Salim, 39 percent by Hino and 10 percent by trading house Sumitomo Corp, a Hino spokesman said.
The venture will have a plant near Jakarta which will be capable of producing about 5,000 medium-sized trucks annually, he said.
It will use engines and transmissions that Hino produces in Indonesia, and other parts will be imported from Japan, he said.
Hino, which has a 28 percent share in the Indonesian truck market, expects to boost its market share by forming the joint venture, the spokesman said.
